extracted.intended_audience: DoD acquisition officials, policymakers, oversight staff, and procurement professionals
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluation of the Department of Defense pilot authority (Section 336) to use best-value source selection in public‑private competitions for IT services under OMB Circular A-76, including whether the authority was used and if it should be extended.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of best value source selection criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 336 authorized DoD to conduct a pilot program to use best value source selection criteria in public-private competitions for information technology (IT) services under Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Circular A-76.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This dimension concerns replacing or supplementing existing selection methods (e.g., lowest cost) with a best-value approach in A-76 competitions. The authority was time-limited (scheduled to expire on September 30, 2008).

rubrics_metrics.name: Effectiveness of the pilot program
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine whether the section 336 pilot authority and its implementation are effective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: GAO was directed to review the pilot program to assess effectiveness; however, officials reported the authority had not been used, so there was no basis for judging effectiveness. Evaluation would require examples of application and measurable outcomes from competitions run under the pilot.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equity of the pilot program
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine whether the section 336 pilot authority and its implementation are equitable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: GAO's review was to include whether the pilot resulted in fair treatment between public and private competitors. As officials indicated the authority had not been used, there was no basis to assess equity. Equity assessment would consider procedural fairness and equal opportunity in public‑private competitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reasons for nonuse of the authority
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify and explain why the section 336 authority was not used by DoD components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of GAO's objectives was to determine the reasons the section 336 pilot authority had not been used. Analysis should cover administrative, policy, legal, cultural, or operational barriers that prevented adoption of best-value A-76 competitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Whether the authority should be extended
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess, given the scheduled expiration, whether DoD officials believe the section 336 authority should be extended.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: GAO was to determine DoD officials' views on extension. This assessment would weigh potential benefits, demonstrated or projected outcomes, and obstacles to implementation when recommending continuation or expiration of the authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope: public-private competitions under OMB Circular A-76 for IT services
rubrics_metrics.description: The pilot applies specifically to public-private competitions for information technology services conducted under OMB Circular A-76.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any evaluation or implementation guidance must be framed within the procedural and legal context of OMB Circular A-76 and its application to IT service competitions.
